name: preset_marine_RHO

meta.description: Marine Mammal Transition & Deep Diving Hypoxia (Cetaceans, Pinnipeds, Sirenians, and Sea Otters.)

notes: signature: resolve_phenotype_vector(taxa, preset=None, foreground=None, background=None, phenotype_file=None, trait_col=None, species_col=None, continuous=False) -> (y float[N], meta{mode, foreground_count, background_count, description}). Priority: phenotype_file, then preset, then foreground. Preset: fnmatch(t.lower(), pat.lower()) or substring. Foreground string split on '|' when it has '|' and no ',', else on ','; each pattern tried as re.search(pat, t, IGNORECASE) then fnmatch/substring with leading/trailing '.*' stripped. background is accepted and ignored. File: sep tab for .tsv/.tab else comma; species column auto-detected from a fixed name list else column 0; trait = first other column; values matched exact, lower, then substring either way in dict insertion order; discrete truthy set {1,true,yes,case,foreground,target,positive} plus foreground tokens. taxa = parse order of examples/RHO.fasta.
